Commentary.Commentary: Kevin O'Brien was the pick of the bowlers who managed to pick up four wickets and ended with figure of 4-0-45-4. None of the other bowlers made any difference as their best bowler of the last match, Barry McCarthy got smashed for 69 in his full quota. Ireland will need something really specially to chase this daunting total. Join us for the chase in a short while.

Mohammad Nabi came out in the 13th over and went hammer and tongs to score 89 off just 30 balls. He hardly needed any help as nothing the Irish bowlers tried worked against him. Afghanistan have scored a huge total of 233 on the board which should really boost their chances of inflicting a whitewash.

A crazy batting performance from Afghanistan where they hammered the visitors all round the park. Mohammad Shahzad started smacking the bowlers from the very first over. He kept his charge on and went on to score 72 off just 43 balls. Wickets did fall after it and Ireland would have hoped for a respite but it was not to be.

OUT! Finally gets one right, fires it on the stumps, Nabi looks to go downtown. He hits it too straight and the ball hits the stumps. Rashid had run through and hence Nabi responds. The bowler goes to the stumps at the non-striker's and picks up the stump to run out Nabi. But he has done his job here. What a knock it has been! Rashid Khan and his teammates applaud his effort. Afghanistan finish on 233/8! Phew, need a break to relish this hitting.
The umpire has gone upstairs to check a run out appeal against Mohammad Nabi.
FOUR! The luck favours the brave! Outside off on a length, Nabi looks to smack it through covers but gets it off the inside edge past the keeper for a boundary.
SIX! Fetch that! Low full toss on the stumps, Nabi crouches low and sends it packing it over mid-wicket for a maximum. Three sixes in an over for him.
SIX! TONKED! Length again outside off, Mohammad Nabi gets behind it and lofts it over long off for a maximum. He is on 79 in 27 balls!
SIX! Take one more of those! Fuller outside off, Nabi hits another big one over long off. This is just too easy for him, he is hitting them clean.
Fuller outside off, pushed into covers for a single.
Barry McCarthy is called back into the attack.

FOUR! Sums up the game for Ireland so far! Fuller on middle, Nabi gets across and hammers it through mid-wicket. Two fielders coming across, from deep long on and mid-wicket. The long on fielder gets a hand to it but parries it over the ropes. Nabi keeps taking the game away!
Rashid Khan walks out to bat.

OUT! 4 for KOB! Fuller outside off, Janat lofts it over long off but does not connect well. The fielder, gets under it and pouches it safely. Afghanistan losing wickets in search of the boundaries here.
SIX! Everybody can hit a six for the hosts! Shorter outside off, Karim gets on top of it and connects it with a six over mid-wicket. What a way to get off the mark!
Carves it over point for a single.
FOUR! In the gap! Bowls it on the stumps, Nabi clips it through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Karim Janat is the next man in.

OUT! Shenwari holes out. Shorter outside off, Shenwari looks to go over mid-wicket but gets a top edge. Dockrell once again gets under it at deep mid-wicket and takes it safely. Not the wicket, Ireland dearly wanted but a dot ball nonetheless.
Kevin O'Brien is back for his last over.
SIX! Take a plane to catch that! Fuller outside off, in the zone, Nabi gets under it and lofts it cleanly over the long off fence for a maximum. Another huge over for the hosts, 17 runs off it.
2nd fifty for Mohammad Nabi!
FIFTY! Too full outside off, Nabi slams it down the ground for a boundary. That also brings up his fifty, he has been magnificent here.
Too full outside off, Nabi looks to go through the off side but misses.
Shenwari drives it into covers for a single.

Fuller outside off, Shenwari looks to go over extra cover. Three fielders converge, cover running back, long off coming to his left, sweeper cover going to his right, yet none get to it. Two runs taken.
FOUR! In the gap! Fuller outside off, Shenwari gets across and sweeps it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Stuart Thompson is called back to finish his spell.

SIX! Nabi is playing a blinder! Shorter length outside off, Nabi gets under it and hammers it flat and hard over mid-wicket for a maximum. 21 runs off that over and Nabi has raced away to 48 in just 19 balls!
FOUR! Crashed! Another full toss outside off, Nabi does not miss out again and clobbers it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full outside off, Nabi comes down the track and slams it over extra cover for a couple of runs.
SIX! Maximum off a no ball! Full toss and Nabi makes the most of it by pulling it over backward square leg for a maximum.
Too full on the stumps, Nabi hits it back to the bowler who gets a hand to it. He parries it towards mid-wicket but the bowler goes towards it but no harm done.
Full toss outside off, heaved through mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Slants it down the leg side. The batsman lets it go through. A wide is signaled.
Barry McCarthy is back into the attack.
Fired on the stumps, played back to the bowler.
SIX! Up and over! Fuller outside off, Nabi gets under it and lofts it cleanly over extra cover for a massive maximum.
Drives it through mid off for a single.
Dockrell knew Nabi was coming down, fires it wide outside off. The batsman manages to keep it away from the keeper for a single towrads third man.
FOUR! Too full outside off, Nabi crouches low and guides it down to the third man fence for a boundary. Smart batting! 150 up for Afghanistan!
Flatter on the pads, turned towards square leg for a single.
Flatter on the stumps, Nabi clips it towards mid-wicket for a couple. There is a direct hit at the striker's end but the batsman was well in.
SIX! Fetch that! Flatter on the stumps, Nabi sits low and swings it high and handsome over mid-wicket for a massive, massive biggie.
Lands it on leg, clips it through mid on for a single.
Drives it through mid off for a single.
SIX! Up and over! Floats it on the stumps, Nabi has had enough of the defence, goes for the big one. He seems to have mistimed it but has enough on it to clear the fielder running back from long on.
Flatter on the stumps, Nabi looks to defend off the back foot but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Nabi clips it through mid on for a single.
Fuller on the stumps, Shenwari clips it through mid on for a run to rotate the strike.
Nudges this one through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter on the pads, Nabi fails to clip it through and is hit on his back leg. The keeper clears his throat with a ferocious appeal but the umpire is not interested.
Shorter on off, punched through long on for a single.
Worked through mid-wicket for a single by Nabi.
WIDE! Too full and spearing down the leg side, Nabi again misses his clip. Another wide signaled.
WIDE! Fires it down the leg side for a wide. The bowler is not happy but that was always a wide. Nabi wanted to sweep that one.
George Dockrell is back into the attack.
Floats it on off, Nabi works it through mid on for a single.
Mohammad Nabi makes his way out to the crease.

OUT! The Afghans are collapsing! Flatter outside off, Zadran looks to defend from his crease but gets an outside edge which is snaffled up by the keeper, Wilson. They appeal and the umpire upholds it.
Bowls it outside off, guides it towards backward point.
Samiullah Shenwari is the next man in.

OUT! Shahzad departs! Flatter on the stumps, Shahzad comes down and looks for another biggie over mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep, Dockrell takes another catch and an enterprising innings comes to an end. He raises his bat to the crowd.
Flatter outside off, Zadran gets an inside edge towards backward square leg for a single.
Shorter on off, Shahzad backs away and smacks it towards extra cover for a single.
Change of ends for Jacob Mulder.
Another full toss outside off, hit hard towards covers from his crease.
Full toss outside off, Zadran hits it back to the bowler.
Najibullah Zadran comes out to bat.
OUT! One more departs! Asghar holes out! Fuller on the stumps, Asghar looks to go over long on but finds the fielder, Stuart Thompson. The fielder gets around and pouches a safe catch.
FOUR! Sliced! Full outside off, Asghar goes back to smash it through covers but gets it over backward point for a boundary.
Shahzad comes down, takes this on the full and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! What a shot, Shahzad! McBrine bowls this on the stumps, Shahzad reverse sweeps it over backward point for a maximum.
Andrew McBrine comes on for a bowl.
Shorter in length on the stumps, Shahzad pulls it through square leg for a single.
Brilliant! Yorker on the stumps, Asghar clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Tonked! Length outside off, Stanikzai gets under it and dispatches it over mid-wicket for a biggie. He has not taken his time.
Shahzad smacks it straight to the bowler. Kevin O'Brien gets hit straight on his wrists and there is a swelling developing. The physio is out there to treat him.

That must have hurt! Almost through KOB! Fuller outside off, Shahzad gets across and slams it hard back down the wicket. The bowler gets a hand to it to catch it but the force was too much for him. It deflects towards long on for a single.
Free hit coming up....
On a length outside off, Stanikzai comes down and pulls it hard through square leg for a single. The umpire signals it a no ball for overstepping. As if Shahzad need a chance to face a Free Hit!
Asghar Stanikzai walks out to the middle.
OUT! Timber! Bowls it on a length just around off, Ghani comes down having a swing at it. He misses but KOB does not. Ghani will rue his bad shot as he walks back to the hut. End of the 74-run stand.
Low full toss on the stumps, Shahzad moves a long way across. Had he missed would have been out but he gets his bat down in time to get it through square leg for a single.
WIDE! Sprays it wide outside off, Shahzad looks to smash it through covers but spots that it is too wide and leaves it. Wide signaled.
Kevin O'Brien is back into the attack.
Sprayed on the pads, Ghani stays in his crease and defends it.
Ghani gets behind the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Short delivery into the stumps, Shahzad camps back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Full outside off, Shahzad kneels down and slaps it through the cover region for a boundary. The fielder from sweeper cover cuts it down with a dive but is not confident if he saved the ball completely. The umpires go upstairs to check and the replays show that the fielder saved the ball but his body was in contact of the ball as he went past the ropes. So it is a boundary.
Floated outside off, Ghani guides it late towards the third man region for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Ghani cuts it towards the fielder at point.
Outside off, Ghani pushes it towards mid off for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. A direct hit would have been close.
FOUR! Good shot! Length delivery into the stumps, Ghani drives it uppishly through the long on region for a boundary.
FOUR! Lucky! Length delivery outside off, Ghani tries to drive it but gets a bottom edge which runs through the vacant slip region for a boundary.
Good length delivery outside off, Ghani clips it straight towards the fielder at point. The fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses as Shahzad wanted a run there.
Down the leg side, Ghani tries to clip it but misses. The ball went off the pads and straight into the gloves of the keeper. The players appeal but the umpire stays put.
Full outside off, Shahzad smacks it straight down the ground towards long off for a single.
Leg spinner in the line of the stumps, Ghani tries to run it down through the third man region but misses.
FOUR! Beautiful! Full outside off, Ghani stays in his crease and drives it crisply down the ground for a boundary.
Outside off, Shahzad punches it through covers for a single.
Flighted outside off, Ghani pushes it through covers for a single.
50-run stand up!
Quicker one into the stumps, Shahzad eases it down towards long on for a single.
Floated outside off, Shahzad cuts it straight to the fielder at point.
Jacob Mulder comes on for a bowl.
Down the leg side, Ghani clips it through the square leg region. The fielder from fine leg runs towards his left and dives to save a certain boundary. The batsmen run a couple.
Length delivery outside off, Ghani cuts it straight to the fielder at point.
Full delivery into the stumps, Shahzad drives it down the ground towards long off for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Shahzad tries to reach it but he misses as it was too wide.
Length delivery outside off, Shahzad slices it over the point region for a couple.
2 WIDES! Way down the leg side, Ghani leaves it alone. The keeper cannot collect it and the batsmen run a bye.
12th T20I fifty for Mohammad Shahzad!
Fifty! On the pads, Shahzad clips it through the mid on region for a single. Another fifty for this dashing opener. He is off to a flier.
WIDE! Wide outside off, Shahzad thinks of going for it but it was too wide for him. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Stuart Thompson is the new bowler for Ireland.
Slight delay in play as Shahzad is struggling with his left calf muscle.
Full into the stumps, Shahzad eases it down towards long on for a single.
SIX! Up and over! Angling into the stumps from a fuller length, Shahzad gets under it and hammers it over the extra cover region for a biggie. This man is looking very, very dangerous.
Low full toss outside off, Shahzad drives it powerfully towards the fielder at covers.
FOUR! Top shot! Short into the body, MS moves away and slaps it over the point region for a boundary.
Slower delivery outside off, Shahzad sits down and tries to slog it on the leg side but he finally gets it towards mid off for a single.
Angling into the pads, Ghani moves away and clips it towards long on for a single.
Barry McCarthy return for a bowl.
SIX! Going, going, gone! Fuller in length on the stumps, Shahzad gets in line and sends it packing over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Chance! Shorter length on the body, Ghani looks to pull it. The ball lobs to the left of the keeper, who goes to towards it but cannot hold onto the chance. A single taken.
Quick single! Shahzad picks one towards mid on and takes the fielder on. By the time the fielder comes in from mid-wicket, the batsmen run through for a single.
FOUR! Thumped! Length ball on off, Shahzad heaves it through mid-wicket for a boundary. He dragged that one through the fielder inside the ring. Afghanistan are racing away here.
Shahzad looks to give himself room, KOB follows him up and cramps him for room. Shahzad can only defend it towards the on side.
Fuller outside off, Ghani looks to go over mid off, coming down the wicket but ends up dragging it through mid on for a single.
SIX! Up and over! Floats it on the stumps, Shahzad gives himself room again and this time goes over the long off fence for a maximum. Superb striking from the Afghan opener.
Fuller outside off, Shahzad comes over it and defends it.
FOUR! Crashed! Dockrell drops it short on the stumps, Shahzad goes back and thumps it through extra cover for a boundary. He gave himself ample of time there.
This one is nudged towards short mid-wicket but not for any runs.
Fired on the pads, turned towards mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter length on the stumps, Shahzad sits low and sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Fuller in length on the stumps, worked through square leg for a couple of runs by Ghani.
Lands it outside off, pushed towards mid on from his crease for a single.
Usman Ghani is the next man in.

OUT! Tarakai departs! Fuller outside off, Tarakai gets under it and looks to swing it over mid-wicket. The ball goes straight into the hands of Dockrell who takes it safely. The star player from the last game departs. Afghanistan have been jolted early.
Bowls it on a length, Shahzad comes down to have a go but spots that it is too close to him. He gets it off the pads towards square leg and takes a leg bye.
Full outside off, Shahzad turns it towards mid-wicket from his crease.
Outside off on a length, Tarakai lifts it to the right of the bowler for a single down the ground. That went through the legs of Shahzad who took evasive action.
Kevin O'Brien comes on for a bowl.
Full on the stumps, Tarakai eases it down to long on for a single.
On the pads, Shahzad clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR LEG BYES! Way down the leg side this time, Shahzad tries to clip it but misses. The ball clips his pads and runs behind the keeper for a boundary.
Tossed up outside off, Shahzad shuffles and pushes it back to the bowler.
Down the leg side, Tarakai flicks it through square leg for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
George Dockrell to bowl from the other end.
FOUR! Square drives this one through backward point for a boundary. What an over for Afghanistan!
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
SIX! This time he lofts this one over extra cover for a maximum. Bright start for Afghanistan.
FOUR! Width and crashed! Shahzad hits one hard through backward point for a boundary.
Defends this one back down the wicket.
The players are out in the middle. Mohammad Shahzad and Najeeb Tarakai come out to bat. Barry McCarthy to begin the proceedings.
TOSS - IRELAND WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO FIELD. Ireland remain unchanged. Afghanistan bring in Usman Ghani in place of Shafiqullah.

Pitch Report - Ajay Mehra informs we are playing on a different surface today. There is less grass on this wicket and despite the rain last night, it is very dry. He reckons the captain winning the toss should bat first.

Ireland would know that they missed out a golden chance to stay alive in the series and will be hoping to make most of this chance to break the unbeaten T20I winning streak of Afghanistan. The game becomes important for them as a loss would mean Afghanistan will carry the momentum into the ODI series. It promises to be an exciting game.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of the third and final T20I between Afghanistan and Ireland at the  Greater Noida Sports Complex Ground, Greater Noida. The previous game saw a remarkable comeback by the home side, led by Rashid Khan who took 2-1-3-5! The hosts are now on the cusp of a 3-0 whitewash and will be backing their all-round side to inflict it.
